description: Simple SOC-voltage model: V = OCV(SOC) - I*R_internal

cell.name: Generic LTO 18650-class cell (Li4Ti5O12 anode vs LMO/NMC cathode)
cell.source: Takami et al. (2011), J. Power Sources 196, 6989; Toshiba SCiB datasheet

internal_resistance.note: Approximate DC resistance at 25C, 50% SOC; LTO has very low impedance

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) polynomial fit: OCV = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 + a4*SOC^4 + a5*SOC^5
ocv_coefficients.source: Polynomial fit to representative LTO discharge curve (flat ~2.4 V plateau)

current.note: Negative=charge, Positive=discharge; LTO supports very high C-rates
